body:
## Code Review

This pull request introduces a new script to run a deterministic MS page-locator backfill harness across 3530 governed rows, generating a runtime locator inventory, blocker map, and readback markdown, along with a comprehensive test suite. The code review feedback focuses on enhancing robustness and error handling, including normalizing and filtering input collections to prevent TypeErrors, explicitly verifying threshold values as finite numbers before comparisons, adding explicit type validation checks for expected array fields, and incorporating fail-closed regression test cases in the unit tests.

> The [consumer version of Gemini Code Assist on GitHub](https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/review-repo-code) is being sunset. Starting **June 18, 2026**, new organization installations will be blocked, and all code review activity will officially cease on **July 17, 2026**.
